author: The Linux Foundation
description:
Daniel Krook of CNCF explains how project maturity levels show which open source AI projects are ready for production.

Full article and transcript: https://tfir.io/open-source-ai-stack-production-ready-cncf/

More of the AI stack is open source every day, from training to inference to agents. The hard part is knowing which projects are production ready and which will have a community that supports them long term.

In this exclusive interview with Swapnil Bhartiya at TFiR, Daniel Krook, Senior Director of Developer Experience at the Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF), explains how the CNCF ecosystem is handling AI workloads, stateful data, GPU scarcity and a flood of AI-generated code.

Key Topics Covered:
- Maturity levels: Sandbox, Incubation and Graduated, and how the TOC uses AI for due diligence
- Kubernetes as the AI OS: Kubeflow for training, LLMD for distributed inference, and new projects for agents
- Running PostgreSQL on Kubernetes with CloudNativePG, from sandbox to
title: Kubernetes Is Becoming the AI OS: Your Open Source AI Stack | Daniel Krook, CNCF
